name: Mason Hubbard
bio:
Mason Massimo Hubbard (born March 12, 2003) is an Italian-Australian film director, writer, producer & actor. He was born in Sydney, Australia where he first started filmmaking and premiering his short films in the North-West area.

In 2020, Mason Hubbard founded the production company, Play These Loud.

Description above was updated 18, Apr 2026.

credits.title: Ramon's Revenge
credits.overview: A young boy stumbles across a deserted stash of cocaine.

credits.title: In Vain
credits.overview: A psychological portrait that delves into the inner disintegration of a woman forced to carry the weight of impossible ideals of self-image, motherhood, and faith.

credits.title: Think Pink
credits.overview: An ordinary boy gives an ill-minded friend a lift to the pharmacy and tells him a horrifying secret concerning his sister.

credits.title: Sweet Tooth
credits.overview: Set in 1780, Sweet Tooth is a dark and magical fairy tale film inspired by the classic story of Hansel and Gretel by the Brothers Grimm, but it is the untold story of the wicked witch and her infamous gingerbread house.

credits.title: Dreamweaver
credits.overview: A young boy moves to a new neighbourhood and discovers his passion for go-karting.
